title: Siebert's formula for virtual pullbacks
summary: For a DM-type morphism of algebraic stacks $f \colon X \to Y$ with a relative perfect obstruction theory $\mathbb{E} \to \mathbb{L}_{X/Y}$ having a global resolution, we give a formula for the induced virtual pullback in terms of $\mathbb{E}$ and $f$. We apply our formula to prove functoriality properties of the virtual fundamental class in Gromov-Witten theory.
